content.title: Double-support elastic couple｜Controller driven deformation reset
content.summary: Let the two graphic characters be bound to a continuously visible physical support respectively; only one readable control parameter is changed in each round, and the binding rules are proved by testing common response, independent response, and a third relationship. Finally, the two supports are stabilized again and the final state of the two characters is restored.

quick_start.input_format: Two visible supports bind dual roles + shared response + independent response + third relationship test + ownership not interchangeable + final state of pairing
quick_start.recommended_input: In the original magnetic suspension observation room, two brass gimbal bases are located in independent concentric rings; base A is equipped with a cyan square eye seed pod, and base B is an amber crescent eye seed pod; the two bases run around the central calibration mark along different radii, and the two seed pods form a coupled surround but the tether is always separated; the two bases enter the side-by-side slots, the diagonal tension is released, and the two seed pods return to a compact and legible form; the eye mark, tether and docking light stay in the same frame
required_anchors: Establish two distinct graphic characters, each visibly bound to one stable physical support.
Change one measurable support parameter and make both characters answer through a readable shared response.
Apply a third materially different support relation or controller path without repeating the prior response.
Synchronize both supports and finish with two legible characters still attached to their original sides.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Let the two graphic characters be bound to a continuously visible physical support respectively; only one readable control parameter is changed in each round, and the binding rules are proved by testing common response, independent response, and a third relationship. Finally, the two supports are stabilized again and the final state of the two characters is restored.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Bind two simple graphic characters to two continuously visible physical supports. Change only one measurable support parameter at a time so the pair first demonstrates a shared response, then an asymmetric independent response, then a third materially different relation test. The order, axis and controller may change across instances; character identity and support ownership must remain readable until both supports stabilize into a legible paired state.

invariants.rule: Establish two distinct graphic characters, each visibly bound to one stable physical support.
invariants.ablation_failure: Floating characters with no support cannot make gesture causality readable.

invariants.rule: Change one measurable support parameter and make both characters answer through a readable shared response.
invariants.purpose: Defines the first causal response rule without prescribing compression or an axis.
invariants.ablation_failure: Changing body shape without a matching support change feels arbitrary.

invariants.rule: Change a different parameter asymmetrically so one character responds while both bindings remain intact.
invariants.purpose: Proves independent control inside the duet.
invariants.ablation_failure: Applying identical changes to both sides never demonstrates separate ownership.

invariants.rule: Apply a third materially different support relation or controller path without repeating the prior response.
invariants.purpose: Shows a reusable control grammar rather than one canned deformation sequence.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeating the same axis and order makes the middle a surface routine.

invariants.rule: Synchronize both supports and finish with two legible characters still attached to their original sides.
invariants.purpose: Restores the relationship after extreme deformation.
invariants.ablation_failure: Losing a face, swapping sides or ending as abstract ribbons breaks identity closure.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source dark-haired woman in a white sweater and beige trousers
the source cream goose-like cartoon blobs with tiny eyes and orange beaks
the source apartment interior and fixed vertical framing
the source exact palm choreography and extreme long-neck ending

instantiations.concept: In an original magnetic observatory, two motorized gimbal bases carry distinct luminous seed-pod characters. Opposite base rotations twist the pods independently, both bases then orbit one central marker while the tethers remain separate, one base tilts to create a single oblique sail response, and the bases finally dock side by side so both pods settle into compact readable forms.

instantiations.concept: On a circular felt loom, two autonomous shuttle discs carry stitched cloud characters. A shared phase pulse makes both clouds ripple, one shuttle alone takes a zigzag rail and turns its cloud into a folded fan, the discs exchange inner and outer circular lanes without crossing ownership, and two latch stations stop them as a balanced paired emblem.
